description: This file defines the class VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper, which adjusts frame release timestamps for smoother video playback by synchronizing with display vsync signals and compensating for drift and playback rate changes.

classes.name: VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper
classes.description: A utility class to adjust video frame release times for smoother playback by aligning with display vsync and compensating for drift.

classes.name: VSyncSampler
classes.description: A singleton helper class that samples display vsync timestamps using Choreographer, shared across instances of VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper.

methods.name: adjustReleaseTime
methods.description: Adjusts a frame's release timestamp based on presentation time, unadjusted release time, and playback rate, aligning with vsync and correcting drift.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the timestamp adjustment helper, starting vsync sampling if applicable.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the helper and stops vsync sampling.

methods.name: onSynced
methods.description: Hook method called when synchronization occurs; default does nothing.
